summary: First-finish smoke test for BEVOQ fashion e-commerce. Backend (health, seed data, auth, products/filters, collections, newsletter, wishlist, checkout with WELCOME10, orders, admin dashboard/RBAC/orders/customers/payments) all working. Frontend (home hero, all products listing with 8 cards, PDP with size/color/add-to-cart, cart display, admin login redirect to /admin dashboard) all rendering correctly.
passed: Seed data verified: 8 products, 7 collections, admin@bevoq.com + customer@bevoq.com
POST /api/auth/login customer@bevoq.com returns role=customer + JWT + seeded address
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns user
POST /api/checkout with WELCOME10 + COD creates order successfully
GET /api/admin/dashboard/stats returns 200 for admin, 403 for customer (RBAC works)
Frontend home renders hero, navigation, announcement bar with WELCOME10
Frontend /products lists 8 product cards with SORT/CATEGORY/SIZE filters
Frontend /products/camel-wool-coat PDP renders with testids: product-title, product-price, size-S/M/L, color-Camel/Black, qty-display, add-to-cart-btn
Add-to-cart flow: select size+color -> click add-to-cart -> cart shows Camel Wool Coat with Size S Camel, subtotal ₹6,499, delivery FREE, checkout button visible
Admin login form (admin-login-email/password/submit testids) authenticates and redirects to /admin dashboard showing revenue chart, customers list, recent orders
action_items: NOTE: Product detail route is /products/:slug (not /product/:slug). Testids listed in problem statement mention 'product-card-threads-platform' but actual slugs are like 'camel-wool-coat' - update problem statement testid examples if needed.
mocked_apis_noted: Razorpay payment_method accepted without gateway call (as designed)
Order confirmation emails logged as [MOCK EMAIL] (as designed)
